S. repeatedly insists that the full equality of women is a necessary condition of a good society;
see e.g. L&C II xxxiv–xlv, VIII xv.
 For S., passion had no necessary conflict with reason, but its expression was distorted by ruling
prejudices; cp. lines 193–9 below, and see Q Mab v 20–1 and note (for Godwin’s influence on S.’s think-
ing in this respect), viii 231–4.

 nepenthe] See II iv 60 and note.

i 16, and Revelation xx 4: ‘And I saw thrones, and they sat upon them, and judgement was given unto
them . . .’. prisons —] prisons, Nbk 9; prisons; 1820, 1839.
